expectation: An Ni-Al contribution is expected only where nickel is already high (Ni >= 12 wt%). Floreen 1964.
reason: Where nickel is at least 12 wt%, higher aluminium receives positive SHAP. Default RF, tuned RF, and tuned XGB agree.

expectation: No global sign was declared. Carbon is an interstitial and a carbide former, and it also separates the small tool-steel group.
reason: No sign was declared before the run, so the measured association is reported and not scored. Default RF, tuned RF, and tuned XGB agree.

expectation: Cobalt is reported to lower molybdenum solubility and to amplify molybdenum hardening, while precipitating little itself. Floreen and Speich 1964.
reason: Higher concentration receives positive SHAP globally and inside at least one large family, and the other large family does not reverse it. Default RF, tuned RF, and tuned XGB agree.

expectation: A global negative association is expected to be the stainless-versus-maraging mix, not a within-steel weakening by chromium.
reason: The chromium pattern does not match the predeclared between-family pattern cleanly. Default RF, tuned RF, and tuned XGB agree.
